svg.title: Circle with secants from Q, angles 28° and 34°
svg.desc: A circle with four points on its edge: P and N near the top, and T and M near the bottom right. A point Q sits outside the circle to the left. A straight line runs from Q through P and on to N. Another straight line runs from Q through T and on to M. Inside the circle, a line joins P to M and another joins T to N, and these two lines cross each other. At Q, the angle between line QN and line QM is marked 28°. At M, the angle between chord MP and the line MT, which continues on to Q, is marked 34°.
